# Magnify Impact

> People-first AI adoption for small mission-driven non-profits in the San Francisco Bay Area. We help good people doing good work spend less time on mechanics and more time on their mission.

Magnify Impact offers three customized services as a menu, with no ranked or primary service. Small businesses, solopreneurs, and non-technical professionals are also welcome. Every engagement starts by learning the organization: its mission, people, processes, and how work gets done.

## Services

- **Customized AI integration consulting**: Find the best value implementation options: AI integrations that deliver high ROI and mission impact.
- **Training and organizational development**: Prepare leaders and teams for AI, with training and change management grounded in the organization's mission, culture, and readiness.
- **Customized AI and automation builds**: Build tools and workflows around the organization's needs, values, and systems so staff can focus on the mission.

## Core Commitments

- **Develop People**: Bring leaders and staff along before, during, and after technology deployment. AI adoption succeeds when people have the preparation and support to use it well.
- **Customize Tools**: Understand the organization, its process pain points, and what matters most to it. Ground recommendations and builds in its values and measure results in mission impact as well as ROI.

## Pricing and intake

Accessible flat fees reflect the agreed scope of each engagement. The initial intake session has no required fee; a suggested donation is welcome. It is a chance to learn about the organization and discuss where Magnify Impact can help.

## Founder

Philip — background in nonprofit and mission-driven work, organizational development, leadership development, and hands-on AI deployment.
